title: BrainOn Admin · Operations Dashboard
description: BrainOn SYSTEM_ADMIN 운영 대시보드. 실제 PostgreSQL/Loki 데이터 기반 Overview, AI/Integration 운영 현황, Runtime 오류 및 request_id 통합 추적.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
        COUNT(*)::bigint AS value
    FROM accounts_user

panels.title: API / 시스템 상태
panels.description: HTTP health/RPS/latency application metric은 현재 Prometheus에 없습니다.

panels.title: AI 분석 건수

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COUNT(*)::bigint AS value
FROM ai_aianalysis
WHERE $__timeFilter(requested_at)

panels.description: 현재 Grafana 시간 범위에 요청된 AIAnalysis 건수.

panels.title: AI 성공률

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
    CASE
        WHEN COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status IN ('COMPLETED', 'FAILED')) = 0
            THEN NULL
        ELSE ROUND(
            100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'COMPLETED')
            / NULLIF(
                COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status IN ('COMPLETED', 'FAILED')),
                0
            ),
            1
        )
    END AS value
FROM ai_aianalysis
WHERE $__timeFilter(requested_at)

panels.description: 종료 상태(COMPLETED/FAILED) 중 COMPLETED 비율.

panels.title: 비정상 운영 이벤트

targets.rawSql: SELECT ((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM audit_auditlog WHERE $__timeFilter(occurred_at) AND COALESCE(outcome,'UNKNOWN') NOT IN ('SUCCESS','SUCCEEDED','COMPLETED','OK')) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ai_aianalysis WHERE $__timeFilter(requested_at) AND status IN ('FAILED','ERROR','TIMEOUT','CANCELLED')) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM interoperability_integrationtransaction WHERE $__timeFilter(started_at) AND status IN ('FAILED','ERROR','TIMEOUT')))::bigint AS value

panels.description: 선택 기간의 Audit 비성공 + AI 실패 + Integration 실패 합계. Grafana/Loki 알림 건수와 동일한 의미가 아닙니다.

panels.title: BrainOn 운영 Activity

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(occurred_at,'5m'), 'Audit' AS metric, COUNT(*)::double precision AS value FROM audit_auditlog WHERE $__timeFilter(occurred_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(requested_at,'5m'), 'AI Analysis' AS metric, COUNT(*)::double precision AS value FROM ai_aianalysis WHERE $__timeFilter(requested_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(started_at,'5m'), 'Integration' AS metric, COUNT(*)::double precision AS value FROM interoperability_integrationtransaction WHERE $__timeFilter(started_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.description: Audit, AI 요청, Integration 및 Loki runtime event의 실제 발생량입니다. HTTP request traffic으로 해석하지 않습니다.

panels.title: 운영 Summary

targets.rawSql: SELECT item,state FROM (SELECT 1 AS sort, 'Audit 이벤트' AS item, COUNT(*)::text AS state FROM audit_auditlog WHERE $__timeFilter(occurred_at) UNION ALL SELECT 2, 'AI 분석 요청', COUNT(*)::text FROM ai_aianalysis WHERE $__timeFilter(requested_at) UNION ALL SELECT 3, 'Integration 거래', COUNT(*)::text FROM interoperability_integrationtransaction WHERE $__timeFilter(started_at) UNION ALL SELECT 4, 'DB 세션', COUNT(*)::text FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE datname=current_database() UNION ALL SELECT 5, 'HTTP RPS', '미수집 · Metric 미연결') summary ORDER BY sort

panels.description: 선택 기간 DB 기반 운영 요약. HTTP RPS는 애플리케이션 Prometheus metric 미연결로 미수집입니다.

panels.title: API 요청 / 오류 추이
panels.description: BrainOn HTTP request, error, latency metric이 현재 Prometheus에 수집되지 않습니다.

panels.title: AI 상태 변화 추이

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
    $__timeGroupAlias(occurred_at, '30m'),
    status AS metric,
    COUNT(*)::double precision AS value
FROM ai_aianalysisstatushistory
WHERE $__timeFilter(occurred_at)
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1

panels.description: AIAnalysisStatusHistory의 실제 상태 전이 이벤트를 30분 단위로 집계.

panels.title: Integration 상태 요약

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
    source_system || ' → ' || target_system AS integration,
    status,
    COUNT(*) AS events,
    MAX(started_at) AS last_seen,
    ROUND(
        AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (completed_at - started_at)) * 1000)
    )::bigint AS avg_latency_ms
FROM interoperability_integrationtransaction
WHERE $__timeFilter(started_at)
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY last_seen DESC

panels.description: 실제 IntegrationTransaction을 source/target/status별로 집계.

panels.title: 비동기 작업 상태
panels.description: RabbitMQ/Celery queue depth, processing, retry metric은 exporter 미연결 상태입니다.

options.content:
### 미수집
Celery/RabbitMQ **queue depth, 대기, 처리 중, retry** 지표는 아직 Prometheus/Exporter에 연결되지 않았습니다.

실제 metric 연결 전까지 수치를 생성하지 않습니다.

panels.title: Runtime Errors · Backend / Celery / RabbitMQ / Assistant / MCP
최근 장애 및 운영 알림

targets.rawSql: SELECT * FROM (SELECT occurred_at AS "Time", 'AUDIT' AS "Layer", source_service AS "Service", action AS "Event", outcome AS "Status", NULL::text AS "Code" FROM audit_auditlog WHERE $__timeFilter(occurred_at) AND COALESCE(outcome,'UNKNOWN') NOT IN ('SUCCESS','SUCCEEDED','COMPLETED','OK') UNION ALL SELECT COALESCE(completed_at,updated_at,requested_at), 'AI', 'ai-analysis', analysis_type, status, failure_code FROM ai_aianalysis WHERE $__timeFilter(requested_at) AND status IN ('FAILED','ERROR','TIMEOUT','CANCELLED') UNION ALL SELECT COALESCE(completed_at,started_at), 'INTEGRATION', source_system||' → '||target_system, message_type, status, error_code FROM interoperability_integrationtransaction WHERE $__timeFilter(started_at) AND status IN ('FAILED','ERROR','TIMEOUT')) alerts ORDER BY "Time" DESC LIMIT 100

panels.description: DB에 기록된 비성공 Audit, AI 실패, Integration 실패만 표시합니다. 현재 없으면 No data입니다.

targets.rawSql: SELECT occurred_at AS "Time", actor_login_id AS "Actor", actor_role_code AS "Role", source_service AS "Service", action AS "Action", outcome AS "Outcome", request_id::text AS request_id FROM audit_auditlog WHERE actor_role_code='SYSTEM_ADMIN' AND $__timeFilter(occurred_at) ORDER BY occurred_at DESC LIMIT 100

panels.description: SYSTEM_ADMIN 감사 이벤트 최소 메타데이터. PHI, reason, before/after JSON, IP, user-agent는 제외합니다.

panels.title: PostgreSQL Exporter Metric

options.content:
## 미수집
`pg_up{job="brainon-postgresql"}` series가 현재 Prometheus에 없습니다. PostgreSQL datasource 쿼리는 정상입니다.

panels.description: Exporter series 부재를 DOWN으로 오해하지 않도록 미수집으로 표시합니다.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
    r.code AS role_code,
    COUNT(*) AS total,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (
        WHERE u.is_active = TRUE
    ) AS active,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (
        WHERE u.is_active = FALSE
    ) AS inactive
FROM accounts_user u
JOIN roles r
  ON r.id = u.role_id
GROUP BY r.code
ORDER BY r.code

SELECT
        COALESCE(
            state,
            'UNKNOWN'
        ) AS state,
        COUNT(*) AS sessions
    FROM pg_stat_activity
    WHERE datname = current_database()
    GROUP BY state
    ORDER BY sessions DESC

SELECT
        occurred_at AS time,
        request_id,
        source_service,
        action,
        resource_type,
        resource_id,
        outcome
    FROM audit_auditlog
    WHERE actor_role_code = 'SYSTEM_ADMIN'
      AND $__timeFilter(
            occurred_at
          )
    ORDER BY occurred_at DESC
    LIMIT 200

panels.title: Request Summary

targets.rawSql: WITH events AS (SELECT occurred_at t,'AUDIT' layer,outcome status FROM audit_auditlog WHERE NULLIF(${request_id:sqlstring},'') IS NOT NULL AND request_id::text=${request_id:sqlstring} UNION ALL SELECT requested_at,'AI',status FROM ai_aianalysis WHERE NULLIF(${request_id:sqlstring},'') IS NOT NULL AND trace_id=${request_id:sqlstring} UNION ALL SELECT started_at,'AI_ATTEMPT',status FROM ai_aianalysisattempt WHERE NULLIF(${request_id:sqlstring},'') IS NOT NULL AND trace_id=${request_id:sqlstring} UNION ALL SELECT h.occurred_at,'AI_STATUS',h.status FROM ai_aianalysisstatushistory h JOIN ai_aianalysis a ON a.id=h.analysis_id WHERE NULLIF(${request_id:sqlstring},'') IS NOT NULL AND a.trace_id=${request_id:sqlstring} UNION ALL SELECT started_at,'INTEGRATION',status FROM interoperability_integrationtransaction WHERE NULLIF(${request_id:sqlstring},'') IS NOT NULL AND trace_id=${request_id:sqlstring}), s AS (SELECT COUNT(*) total,MIN(t) first_event,MAX(t) last_event,COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE layer='AUDIT') audit_count,COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE layer LIKE 'AI%') ai_count,COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE layer='INTEGRATION') integration_count,COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE UPPER(COALESCE(status,'')) IN ('FAILED','FAILURE','ERROR','TIMEOUT','CANCELLED')) failure_count,COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE UPPER(COALESCE(status,'')) IN ('SUCCESS','SUCCEEDED','COMPLETED','OK')) success_count FROM events) SELECT ${request_id:sqlstring} AS "Request ID",first_event AS "First event",last_event AS "Last event",audit_count AS "Audit",ai_count AS "AI",integration_count AS "Integration",failure_count AS "Failures",CASE WHEN total=0 THEN 'NO SERVER EVIDENCE' WHEN success_count>0 AND failure_count>0 THEN 'MIXED OUTCOMES' WHEN failure_count>0 THEN 'FAILURE EVIDENCE' WHEN success_count>0 THEN 'SUCCESS ONLY' ELSE 'NO TERMINAL OUTCOME' END AS "Server evidence" FROM s WHERE NULLIF(${request_id:sqlstring},'') IS NOT NULL

panels.description: 빈 request_id는 0행을 반환합니다. DB에 저장된 서버측 증거만 집계합니다.

panels.title: Outcome Divergence

targets.rawSql: WITH statuses AS (SELECT outcome status FROM audit_auditlog WHERE NULLIF(${request_id:sqlstring},'') IS NOT NULL AND request_id::text=${request_id:sqlstring} UNION ALL SELECT status FROM ai_aianalysis WHERE NULLIF(${request_id:sqlstring},'') IS NOT NULL AND trace_id=${request_id:sqlstring} UNION ALL SELECT at.status FROM ai_aianalysisattempt at LEFT JOIN ai_aianalysis a ON a.id=at.analysis_id WHERE NULLIF(${request_id:sqlstring},'') IS NOT NULL AND (at.trace_id=${request_id:sqlstring} OR a.trace_id=${request_id:sqlstring}) UNION ALL SELECT h.status FROM ai_aianalysisstatushistory h JOIN ai_aianalysis a ON a.id=h.analysis_id WHERE NULLIF(${request_id:sqlstring},'') IS NOT NULL AND a.trace_id=${request_id:sqlstring} UNION ALL SELECT status FROM interoperability_integrationtransaction WHERE NULLIF(${request_id:sqlstring},'') IS NOT NULL AND trace_id=${request_id:sqlstring}), c AS (SELECT COUNT(*) total,COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE UPPER(COALESCE(status,'')) IN ('SUCCESS','SUCCEEDED','COMPLETED','OK')) successes,COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE UPPER(COALESCE(status,'')) IN ('FAILED','FAILURE','ERROR','TIMEOUT','CANCELLED')) failures FROM statuses) SELECT CASE WHEN total=0 THEN 'NO SERVER EVIDENCE' WHEN successes>0 AND failures>0 THEN 'MIXED OUTCOMES' WHEN failures>0 THEN 'FAILURE EVIDENCE' WHEN successes>0 THEN 'SUCCESS ONLY' ELSE 'NO TERMINAL OUTCOME' END AS outcome FROM c WHERE NULLIF(${request_id:sqlstring},'') IS NOT NULL

panels.description: 동일 request_id에 성공과 실패 증거가 함께 있으면 MIXED OUTCOMES입니다.

panels.title: First Failure Signal

targets.rawSql: WITH failures AS (SELECT occurred_at t,'AUDIT' layer,source_service service,action event,outcome status,NULL::text code FROM audit_auditlog WHERE NULLIF(${request_id:sqlstring},'') IS NOT NULL AND request_id::text=${request_id:sqlstring} AND UPPER(COALESCE(outcome,'')) IN ('FAILED','FAILURE','ERROR','TIMEOUT','CANCELLED') UNION ALL SELECT COALESCE(completed_at,updated_at,requested_at),'AI','ai-analysis',analysis_type,status,failure_code FROM ai_aianalysis WHERE NULLIF(${request_id:sqlstring},'') IS NOT NULL AND trace_id=${request_id:sqlstring} AND status IN ('FAILED','ERROR','TIMEOUT','CANCELLED') UNION ALL SELECT COALESCE(finished_at,started_at),'AI_ATTEMPT','ai-attempt','attempt '||attempt_number,status,error_code FROM ai_aianalysisattempt WHERE NULLIF(${request_id:sqlstring},'') IS NOT NULL AND trace_id=${request_id:sqlstring} AND status IN ('FAILED','ERROR','TIMEOUT','CANCELLED') UNION ALL SELECT COALESCE(completed_at,started_at),'INTEGRATION',source_system||' → '||target_system,message_type,status,error_code FROM interoperability_integrationtransaction WHERE NULLIF(${request_id:sqlstring},'') IS NOT NULL AND trace_id=${request_id:sqlstring} AND status IN ('FAILED','ERROR','TIMEOUT')) SELECT t AS "Time",layer AS "Layer",service AS "Service",event AS "Event",status AS "Status",code AS "Code" FROM failures UNION ALL SELECT NULL,'INFO','server','서버측 실패 신호 없음','NO FAILURE EVIDENCE',NULL WHERE NULLIF(${request_id:sqlstring},'') IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM failures) ORDER BY "Time" ASC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1

panels.description: 서버 DB에 저장된 최초 실패 신호. 없으면 서버측 실패 신호 없음으로 표시합니다.

panels.title: Unified Timeline

targets.rawSql: SELECT * FROM (SELECT occurred_at AS "Time",'AUDIT' AS "Layer",COALESCE(source_service,'audit') AS "Service",action||COALESCE(' · '||resource_type,'') AS "Event",outcome AS "Status",NULL::text AS "Error / Reason" FROM audit_auditlog WHERE NULLIF(${request_id:sqlstring},'') IS NOT NULL AND request_id::text=${request_id:sqlstring} UNION ALL SELECT requested_at,'AI','ai-analysis',analysis_type||COALESCE(' · '||stage,''),status,failure_code FROM ai_aianalysis WHERE NULLIF(${request_id:sqlstring},'') IS NOT NULL AND trace_id=${request_id:sqlstring} UNION ALL SELECT at.started_at,'AI_ATTEMPT','ai-attempt','attempt '||at.attempt_number||COALESCE(' · '||at.stage,''),at.status,at.error_code FROM ai_aianalysisattempt at LEFT JOIN ai_aianalysis a ON a.id=at.analysis_id WHERE NULLIF(${request_id:sqlstring},'') IS NOT NULL AND (at.trace_id=${request_id:sqlstring} OR a.trace_id=${request_id:sqlstring}) UNION ALL SELECT h.occurred_at,'AI_STATUS','ai-status',COALESCE(h.previous_status,'∅')||' → '||h.status||COALESCE(' · '||h.stage,''),h.status,h.reason_code FROM ai_aianalysisstatushistory h JOIN ai_aianalysis a ON a.id=h.analysis_id WHERE NULLIF(${request_id:sqlstring},'') IS NOT NULL AND a.trace_id=${request_id:sqlstring} UNION ALL SELECT started_at,'INTEGRATION',source_system||' → '||target_system,message_type,status,error_code FROM interoperability_integrationtransaction WHERE NULLIF(${request_id:sqlstring},'') IS NOT NULL AND trace_id=${request_id:sqlstring}) timeline ORDER BY "Time" ASC LIMIT 1000

panels.description: Audit, AI Analysis, AI Attempt, AI Status, Integration 서버 이벤트의 시간순 통합 뷰입니다.

panels.title: AuditLog Trace

targets.rawSql: SELECT occurred_at AS "Time",request_id::text AS "Request ID",actor_login_id AS "Actor",actor_role_code AS "Role",source_service AS "Service",action AS "Action",resource_type AS "Resource type",resource_id AS "Resource ID",outcome AS "Outcome" FROM audit_auditlog WHERE NULLIF(${request_id:sqlstring},'') IS NOT NULL AND request_id::text=${request_id:sqlstring} ORDER BY occurred_at ASC LIMIT 500

panels.description: 최소 감사 메타데이터만 표시하며 PHI/reason/before_json/after_json/IP/user-agent는 제외합니다.

panels.title: AI Analysis Trace

targets.rawSql: SELECT requested_at AS "Requested",started_at AS "Started",completed_at AS "Completed",trace_id AS "Trace ID",id AS "Analysis ID",analysis_type AS "Type",status AS "Status",stage AS "Stage",priority AS "Priority",attempt_count AS "Attempts",failure_code AS "Failure code" FROM ai_aianalysis WHERE NULLIF(${request_id:sqlstring},'') IS NOT NULL AND trace_id=${request_id:sqlstring} ORDER BY requested_at ASC LIMIT 500

panels.description: AIAnalysis의 실제 trace_id, 상태, 단계, 시각, 실패 코드입니다.

panels.title: AI Attempt Trace

targets.rawSql: SELECT at.started_at AS "Started",at.finished_at AS "Finished",COALESCE(at.trace_id,a.trace_id) AS "Trace ID",at.analysis_id AS "Analysis ID",at.attempt_number AS "Attempt",at.status AS "Status",at.stage AS "Stage",at.error_code AS "Error code" FROM ai_aianalysisattempt at LEFT JOIN ai_aianalysis a ON a.id=at.analysis_id WHERE NULLIF(${request_id:sqlstring},'') IS NOT NULL AND (at.trace_id=${request_id:sqlstring} OR a.trace_id=${request_id:sqlstring}) ORDER BY at.attempt_number ASC,at.started_at ASC LIMIT 500

panels.description: AIAnalysisAttempt와 상위 Analysis trace_id를 함께 조회합니다.

panels.title: AI Status History

targets.rawSql: SELECT h.occurred_at AS "Time",a.trace_id AS "Trace ID",h.analysis_id AS "Analysis ID",h.previous_status AS "Previous",h.status AS "Status",h.stage AS "Stage",h.reason_code AS "Reason code" FROM ai_aianalysisstatushistory h JOIN ai_aianalysis a ON a.id=h.analysis_id WHERE NULLIF(${request_id:sqlstring},'') IS NOT NULL AND a.trace_id=${request_id:sqlstring} ORDER BY h.occurred_at ASC LIMIT 500

panels.description: analysis_id로 AIAnalysis를 연결하여 request trace에 상태 이력을 포함합니다.

panels.title: Integration Trace

targets.rawSql: SELECT started_at AS "Started",completed_at AS "Completed",trace_id AS "Trace ID",direction AS "Direction",standard AS "Standard",source_system AS "Source",target_system AS "Target",message_type AS "Message type",status AS "Status",attempt_count AS "Attempts",error_code AS "Error code" FROM interoperability_integrationtransaction WHERE NULLIF(${request_id:sqlstring},'') IS NOT NULL AND trace_id=${request_id:sqlstring} ORDER BY started_at ASC LIMIT 500

panels.description: IntegrationTransaction의 실제 trace_id와 처리 결과입니다.

panels.title: Runtime Logs · Request ID
panels.description: 모든 레벨 로그에서 UUID를 추출하고 입력 request_id와 정확히 비교합니다. 빈 입력은 일치하지 않습니다.

panels.title: Prometheus Metrics Context · Collector 자체
panels.description: request_id label을 만들지 않습니다. 현재 실제 존재하는 Prometheus 자체 지표만 시간 문맥으로 표시하며 BrainOn HTTP 트래픽이 아닙니다.

options.content: **브라우저/F12 HTTP status는 현재 서버측 datasource에 request_id와 함께 저장되지 않습니다.** 따라서 F12 실패와 서버 SUCCESS가 다르면 이 화면은 DB Audit/AI/Integration/Loki 증거만 비교하며, 브라우저 응답 status 자체를 확정하지 않습니다. HTTP access log + request_id 수집이 후속으로 필요합니다.
